relationships.subject: SAFit2
relationships.evidence_quote: the comparison of the vehicle and SAFit2-treated SNI animals revealed only the C16 dihydroceramide (d18:0/16:0) as a significantly altered lipid

relationships.subject: C16 dihydroceramide
relationships.evidence_quote: C16 concentration-dependently reduced the calcium transients of TRPV1 in sensory neurons

relationships.subject: C16 dihydroceramide
relationships.evidence_quote: we observed that the C16 concentration dependently also reduced the CGRP amount in the supernatant of the primary sensory neurons, which were treated with capsaicin beforehand

relationships.subject: C16 dihydroceramide
relationships.evidence_quote: we detected that the C16 treatment prevented the development of thermal hypersensitivity after capsaicin treatment in mice

key_findings: SAFit2 restored the SNI-reduced C16 dihydroceramide in DRG, the only lipid differing between vehicle and SAFit2 groups.
C16 dihydroceramide desensitized TRPV1 indirectly, reduced capsaicin-evoked CGRP release and capsaicin thermal hypersensitivity.
